name: Luxmi Kitchen
why_it_matters: Run exclusively by women, this basement spot opposite Ema Market Complex is the most-cited place in Imphal for an honest Manipuri thali — rice, two dals, a pakora kadhi, three vegetable preparations and a side of fried beans, plus fish curry on the non-veg plate. Fixed pricing, freshly cooked, no frills.
insider_tip: Open lunch only, until ~2:30pm — go before 1pm or you risk dishes running out. Cash preferred. Walk down from Ima Keithel; the sign is in the basement opposite the parking stand.
signature_address: Basement, opposite Ema Market Complex parking, Sagolband, Imphal West, Manipur 795001

name: Hotel Imoinu
signature_dish: Non-veg Manipuri thali with 4-5 fish preparations
why_it_matters: Small all-women family-run thali joint serving veg, fish and full non-veg Meitei platters under ₹200. The non-veg thali features four to five different fish recipes — uncommon even by Imphal's standards. Clean, hygienic, and a long-time fixture in Wahengbam Leikai.
insider_tip: Order the fish thali — it's the house specialty. Small dining room means lunch fills up; arrive by 12:30pm. Tripadvisor lists a Thangal Bazaar location too, but the original Wahengbam Leikai address is the one regulars use.
signature_address: Keisampat Wahengbam Leikai Rd, Wahengbam Leikai, Sagolband, Imphal West, Manipur 795004

name: Forage
why_it_matters: Opened winter 2016 by Korou Khundrakpam and Kundo Yumnam — Imphal's first contemporary restaurant to put tribal Manipuri ingredients (hathei chillies, country chicken, foraged herbs) on a Mediterranean menu. No-MSG, no-bottled-water, sourdough and kombucha made in-house. Doubles as a culture venue for poetry and music gigs.
insider_tip: Two flights up to the second floor — no lift. Order across both menus: the 'Neighbourhood' plate for tribal Manipuri, the 'Elsewhere' plate for pasta. Best ambience in town for a long lunch.
signature_address: 2nd Floor, KokSamLai Tower (opp. Thau Ground), DM College Road, Thangmeiband, Imphal West, Manipur 795004

name: The Wild Rice
why_it_matters: The flagship restaurant of Sangai Continental — Imphal's best-known boutique hotel — with an open-kitchen layout and separate veg/non-veg lines visible from the dining room. Reliable choice for travellers who want clean multi-cuisine after a long day at Kangla Fort or Khwairamband.
insider_tip: Walk in for breakfast even if you're not staying — the buffet is one of the more elaborate spreads in the valley. North Indian tandoor is stronger than the Asian section.
signature_address: M.G. Avenue, Thangal Bazar, Imphal West, Manipur 795001

name: Classic Cafe
must_try: live-band Sunday lounge at Rita Cafe
why_it_matters: The Classic Hotel's first-floor restaurant sits directly across the road from the North Gate of Kangla Fort, the historic seat of Meitei kings — making it the most logical lunch stop on a heritage walk. Sister lounge Rita Cafe runs a live band on Sundays.
insider_tip: Ask for a window seat facing the fort moat. Pair lunch with a Kangla Fort visit (closes 5pm). The Classic Hotel's larger sibling Classic Grande (Radisson Individuals) is a separate property in Chinga, not this address.
signature_address: The Classic Hotel, North AOC, opposite Kangla Fort North Gate, Imphal West, Manipur 795001

name: Char-Koal
why_it_matters: Imphal's only proper rooftop pan-Asian spot — the DIY Korean BBQ at the table is the draw. Locals call it the 'Asian Bowl Rooftop' for the bamboo-and-glass canopy. Worth the climb (no lift).
insider_tip: Korean BBQ portions start at 2 people minimum, so go in a group. Sunset on the rooftop is the best seat in central Imphal.
signature_address: Asian Bowl Rooftop, Yaiskul Police Lane, near Krishna Premi Oil Pump, Imphal West, Manipur 795001

name: OK Hotel
signature_dish: Chicken thali with rice, dal and iromba
why_it_matters: An old reliable on M.G. Avenue beside the police station — open 24 hours, popular for chicken-rice plates and a budget Manipuri thali. Locals rate the simplicity; tourists rate the convenience next to Thangal Bazaar shopping.
insider_tip: Order the chicken thali — it's the staple here, served with iromba (mashed-veg-with-fermented-fish chutney). Skip the menu's continental section.
signature_address: Majorkhul, M.G. Avenue, Thangal Bazar, opposite Hotel Nirmala, Imphal West, Manipur 795001

name: The House by Route 39
why_it_matters: An out-of-town garden-cafe on the NH-2 stretch toward Imphal East — ranked for ambience over central Imphal noise. Sit-down brunch spot with both Manipuri and continental plates, popular with families and weekend regulars.
insider_tip: 10 minutes from central Imphal, off NH-2 near Mantripukhri. Best on weekend afternoons. Call ahead — kitchen runs slower than the venue suggests.
signature_address: RWXM+VMV, opp. NH-2 Road, Mantripukhri, Achanbigei, Imphal East, Manipur 795002
